name: Spring Switch
description: Switches with weight: the thumb stretches in its direction of travel and lands on a spring, glyphs sit in the track, and async switches hold a spinner until confirmed.
usage:
import { SwitchSpring } from "@/components/design-for-ai/switch-spring";

<SwitchSpring
  label="Sync to devices"
  description="Pushes changes to your other devices."
  defaultChecked
  async
  onCheckedChange={(next) => api.settings.update({ sync: next })} // return the promise to hold the thumb
/>

<SwitchSpring label="Product updates" size="sm" icons labelSide="right" accent="#7dd3a8" />

props.name: label
props.description: The switch's name, read by screen readers and set beside the track.

props.name: description
props.description: One quiet line under the label, in the muted ink.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled state. Update it from onCheckedChange once the change has landed.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Runs when the person flips the switch. Return a promise to wait on the change; if it rejects, the switch stays where it was.

props.name: async
props.description: Holds the thumb in a spinner until the promise settles, then lands it. Off, the thumb moves at once and a rejection rolls it back.

props.name: size
props.description: Track of 32, 40 or 52 px wide. The label scales with it.

props.name: icons
props.description: Glyphs in the track: a check on the side the thumb has left when on, a cross when off.

props.name: labelSide
props.description: Which side of the track the label sits on. Left reads like a settings list; right suits forms.

props.name: accent
props.description: The fill while on. Leave out for the theme's ink. The dark ink hex #f4f4f5 is read as the theme's ink, so it stays legible on light surfaces.

props.name: theme
props.description: The surface the switch sits on, so its track, thumb and muted text keep their contrast.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the switch and dims the row to 40%.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root, for spacing inside a list.
